title: Business Workflow Automation
summary: Put AI inside real operating processes: triggers, queues, idempotency, n8n-style orchestration, and measured ROI.
outcomes: Map a business process and find where AI adds measurable value
Wire triggers, webhooks, queues, and durable state into reliable workflows
